The Leathernecks, led by first-year head coach [[Rob Jeter]], played their home games at [[Western Hall]] in [[Macomb, Illinois]], as members of the [[Summit League]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Western Illinois Leathernecks men's basketball team|Leathernecks]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 5–21, 2–14 in Summit League play to finish in last place. They failed to qualify for the [[2020 Summit League men's basketball tournament|Summit League tournament]]. On March 3, 2020, the school announced that head coach [[Billy Wright (basketball)|Billy Wright]]'s contract would not be renewed.{{Cite news|url=https://westerncourier.com/47292/news/billy-wright-out-as-mens-basketball-head-coach/|title=Billy Wright out as men's basketball head coach|work=The Western Courier|date=March 4, 2020|accessdate=December 6, 2020|language=en}} He finished at Western Illinois with a six-year record of 53–115. On March 30, the school announced former [[Milwaukee Panthers men's basketball|Milwaukee]] head coach Rob Jeter would be hired as the new head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28973013/w-illinois-hires-rob-jeter-head-men-basketball-coach|title=W.
